phrase.zh: 越远的光，带来越早的消息。

visual.zh: 远处的亮点与向外扩开的空间层次，把深空观测表现为向过去追问。画面没有按真实红移、距离或时间比例绘制。
visual.en: Remote lights and expanding spatial layers turn deep-space observation into a question about the past. Redshift, distance and time are not to scale.

background.zh: 光需要时间传播，所以望远镜看到遥远星系时，也在看到它们更早的状态。韦布空间望远镜以红外观测研究早期星系；这幅画并不对应一张韦布照片。
background.en: Light takes time to travel, so observing a distant galaxy also reveals an earlier stage of it. The Webb Space Telescope uses infrared observations to study early galaxies; this painting is not a Webb image.
